name: virtual-code-agent
description: Virtual Code Agent - LangGraph.js 驱动的编码 Agent（TS 重写版）

scripts.build:web: cd web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run electron:build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:dist:portable: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --win portable
